comment: Wonderful and caring Professor. Wants the best for his students.

Dr. Nigel is one of the nicest people I've ever met, and he is a great professor who teaches clearly and wants you to succeed. It's a chill environment where you put effort in to learn, and Dr. Nigel makes it comfortable in doing so. If you're looking for a kind and caring professor that also has great connections, he is the best.

Highly recommend Dr. Nigel. He makes the lectures engaging and explains concepts the exact way he wants to see them on tests. Weekly take-home quizzes, but nothing to worry about. He's very flexible and accommodating; he really wants to see his students succeed. Super kind and easy to communicate with.

Dr. Nigel is a caring professor and makes the class as useful as it can be. The class itself is very straightforward. There's only one real assignment in the first half of the semester. Then the class stops meeting after spring break so you can do your PDP project. Lots of writing/research/speaking skill building.
Dr. James is a great professor the class is very straightforward and as long as you understand what he says in class you will be fine on the tests. He is also very personal and funny!

Dr. Nigel is an amazing professor. His assignments are clear and all listed in the syllabus. His lectures are comprehensive and prepare you for exams. He is funny and cares a lot about every student. If there is a common struggle in the class, it feels safe to talk to him about it, and he will accommodate the class as best as possible.

Dr. Nigel was/is the best professor I have had at the University of Richmond. If you have the opportunity, you should 100% take HS101 with him. He is caring, kind, interesting, and overall an outstanding professor. His classes are full of content that is explained thoroughly clearly, and concisely. He is incredibly helpful with all assignments.
Dr Nigel was great and had clear grading criteria. Easy A if you read the textbook, engage in class discussions, and look over the lecture slides.

TAKE HIM. The best professor at UR. He is so caring. Homeworks are online and are quizzes/open notes. We have a paper that's due at the end of the semester and is worth a lot. Dr.Nigel sets you up very well to take it. Few projects here and there but very manageable. He is well lived and THE perfect person to teach this course. Also very hilarious!

My favorite class of the semester! Dr. Nigel is one of the best professors in the department and truly cares about his students...is also always down for a good yap session. Class is super easy and quizzes are online / open note, he also gives extra credit as needed. Just pay attention and you'll do well!

I LOVE DR NIGEL! He is hilarious and the class is such an easy A if you read the textbook. He has such a fascinating life story and has engaging and interesting classes with a clear passion for the material. Don't miss out on taking him he is literally the best.

i love dr. nigel! class had very few assignments and you don't even need to read the textbook to do well on the quizzes. exams were pretty hard, but he gave a lot of extra credit. definitely take his class if you can, he really cares about his students and even will come to our sporting events

Dr. Nigel is a great professor and if you get the chance I would recommend taking his class. He is a caring professor who takes time to get to know students and wants to improve his class. There is 1 or 2 textbook readings per week with easy quizzes and not too many tests. Fairly easy if you pay attention and read the textbook.
